title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
tagline: Folding and Outline ranges that stop at the brace, honest supertypes, signature help that counts
summary: Folding, Expand Selection and the Outline end a member at its own closing brace and skip locals. Generic and constructor arguments are no longer supertypes, and a wrapped supertype list is read in full. Signature help counts arguments across strings and generics, lists overloads and private val parameters. The index snapshot is rebuilt once after the update.

highlights.title: Ranges end at the brace
highlights.description: Folding a member hid the next member's KDoc and annotations, folding the last one hid the class's `}`, and Expand Selection from the last function selected up to it. Ranges now stop at the real closing brace, and locals no longer get a chevron or an Outline entry.

highlights.title: Only the type is a supertype
highlights.description: `class ItemAdapter : ListAdapter<Item, ItemViewHolder>(DiffCb)` was a subtype of Item, ItemViewHolder and DiffCb in the hierarchy and the implementation lenses; `BaseViewModel<UiState>(Dispatchers.IO)` put a ViewModel among the subtypes of UiState. A supertype list wrapped over several lines is read in full.

highlights.title: Signature help that counts
highlights.description: A comma inside `"Hello, world"` or `emptyMap<String, Int>()` no longer shifts the highlighted parameter, `private val` constructor parameters and Java parameters are listed, and every overload of `load(` is shown with the right one active.

sections.heading: Structure
bullets: Folding, Expand Selection and Outline ranges end at the member's closing brace; a one-line `val` has no chevron.
Locals of a function body are hidden from the Outline, folding and selection.
Generic arguments, constructor arguments and `by` delegates are not supertypes; a supertype list continued on the next lines is read.
The `⬇ implementations` lens reaches an interface member declared after a nested class, including `val` members.

sections.heading: Signature help and hierarchies
bullets: Commas in strings and generics, parentheses in strings, comments above the call and `"${greet(` templates are handled.
`private val` and `override val` constructor parameters, and Java `Type name` parameters, are listed.
Every overload is shown; the active signature follows the arguments typed.
A call in a property initializer or `init` block has a caller in the call hierarchy; anonymous objects are labelled.
No highlight inside a KDoc or a `"""` block.
